svg.aria-label: Figure 5 — Query planner dispatch cascade trying Typed Single-Table, Typed Join, and Hybrid Vector paths before the General Evaluator fallback
svg.text: Query planner dispatch cascade (first matching path wins)
PK/Index lookup · PK range seek · SIMD Columnar agg · UTF-8 typed scan
2. Typed Join Path (INNER / LEFT on integer keys)
Hash join · DenseInt64Set bit-set probe · Index-driven probe · Top-K
3. Hybrid Vector Path (<=> / <-> ORDER BY ... LIMIT k)
HNSW graph / cost-routed Flat SIMD scan · stored-row candidate filter
DISTINCT · CTEs · window functions · RIGHT/FULL/CROSS joins · tx joins
A fast path either returns the exact same rows as the general evaluator or declines cleanly; declining is never an error.
